pages.text: The Network Transmitter is used to send signals to a Network Receiver, allowing you to create long-distance wireless networks.

To use the Network Transmitter:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Insert a Network Card to configure the transmitting channel$(li)Ensure the channel matches the Network Receiver's channel

The Network Transmitter can be used to extend your network over long distances by sending signals to a Network Receiver. This allows you to create separate network segments that can communicate with each other.
